if: an amount of credit under s.18(1) or an amount payable under s.18(4) has to be quantified
then: it SHALL BE CALCULATED in such manner as may be PRESCRIBED — the Act supplies no formula
note: Same shape as s.17(6): the Act creates the obligation and defers the arithmetic to the Rules. No s.18 amount can be computed from this source alone; the prescribing Rule is not extracted here and is therefore UNKNOWN. The source is the CGST Act as updated 31-08-2021. UNKNOWN whether a later amendment has changed this provision; later amendments are not held locally.

evidence.quote: The amount of credit under sub-section (1) and the amount payable under sub-section (4) shall be calculated in such manner as may be prescribed.
